content: {"episode_id":"ep-05038","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry with 24-hour attended surveillance, was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). Following a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack (G45.9), continuous monitoring was indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control. The documented clinical indications support the medical necessity of this diagnostic service, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on that basis."}
